## Specific task description

Task instruction: Direct the left arm to click the beige switch with darker brown top

Task description: The target is the beige switch on the right side of the head-camera view, with a darker brown movable panel on its base. Use the left arm to press that panel and toggle the switch.

Success criteria: The left arm presses the switch so the movable panel turns near the end of its travel in the intended direction. Merely touching the panel or deflecting it slightly does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- When the left arm approaches the switch from the right, adjust the fingertip orientation in the open area in front of the switch, leaving room for the beverage bottle behind the panel and white bottle beside it.
- Narrow the gripper opening enough for pressing, placing the fingertip on the brown movable panel and avoiding contact between the other finger and the beige fixed frame.
- Use panel rotation under light pressure to identify the effective pressing end. Contact inside that end, away from the pivot and with an edge margin, to obtain sufficient lever arm and reduce slipping.
- Apply a small inward force following the panel’s orientation at the contact point, adjusting contact as the panel turns. If it does not move, check whether you are pressing the frame or the wrong end; avoid continuing to force it.
